one_sentence_story: A single evidence thread carries one source observation through a transparent context test, resolves into a torus family and cusp hexagonal fibre, then closes as a labelled S6 paper claim beside an independently readable world trace.

beats.title: Source observation
beats.causal_move: A warm paper source artifact emits one measured amber thread; nothing else moves yet.
beats.visual: Low, wide orthographic view. A cream evidence folio stands on a dark hexagonal ground plate. Its only legible label is SOURCE OBSERVATION. One amber filament leaves its marked line.
beats.transition: The amber filament advances from the marked line toward the capsule.

beats.title: Context capsule
beats.causal_move: The same thread enters a transparent capsule, where a cool-blue context shell appears around it without changing its path.
beats.visual: The camera tracks with the filament into a glass rectangular capsule. A faint internal grid and one small hexagonal fibre make the context boundary visible; the source folio remains in frame at the far left.
beats.transition: The capsule walls become briefly luminous as the thread crosses the boundary.

beats.title: Topology resolves
beats.causal_move: Inside the capsule, the line folds once into a torus family and exposes a cusp hexagonal fibre as the local structural witness.
beats.visual: The filament makes one controlled loop, becoming three nested torus rings with shared orientation. At the cusp, a small six-sided fibre locks onto the loop; no extra nodes or dashboard elements appear.
beats.transition: The six-sided fibre pulls the blue half of the thread through the final cusp vertex.

beats.title: World trace
beats.causal_move: The blue thread exits the capsule and lands on a cool slate world-trace plate, producing a visible receipt mark.
beats.visual: The camera continues rightward. The thread terminates at a white curled receipt over a concentric trace plate on the same fractured terrain. The torus and capsule stay visible behind it, preserving object continuity.
beats.transition: A single circular pulse travels from the receipt back to the cusp and stops.

beats.title: Claim closes
beats.causal_move: A restrained title card places the proposed S6 claim between the source and trace, while the geometry remains visible as its provenance path.
beats.visual: The terrain dims, leaving the amber source, blue trace, capsule, torus family, cusp fibre, and receipt in a clean horizontal chain. A dark translucent claim panel appears above the chain with large readable type.
beats.claim_text: S6 claim: this evidence-thread construction may connect the observed source to the traced world structure.
beats.transition: The word CLAIM remains; the receipt pulse fades, leaving the proposed status explicit.

caption_script.tweet_caption: One source observation. One context boundary. One topology witness. The S6 connection shown here is a proposed paper claim, carried to a receipt and world trace so the route stays inspectable.

Carry the result to a receipt and world trace.

manim_plan.determinism: Set random_seed=18; use fixed Decimal-like constants for all anchors; no noise, random sampling, or runtime text generation.
construction: Create fixed hexagonal ground plates at x=-5.4,-3.7,-1.9,0.0,1.9,3.7,5.4 with z=-0.8 and deterministic rotations.
Place source_folio at x=-5.0, context_capsule at x=0.0, and world_trace_receipt at x=5.0; keep these anchors unchanged after creation.
Build evidence_thread as one ParametricFunction with five fixed control points; reveal it with Create and color by t interval rather than replacing the spline.
At beat 3, transform only the middle spline interval into three fixed Torus objects and one fixed six-sided fibre; use Rotate and Transform with explicit run_time values.
At beat 4, reveal the receipt pulse with a single Dot moving on the existing spline; stop it at the trace plate.
At beat 5, FadeToColor the terrain and add one claim panel with explicit Text objects for S6 CLAIM, PROPOSED BY PAPER, and RECEIPT + WORLD TRACE.
readability_guards: Use Text, never generated pseudo-text or texture text, for every label.
Keep labels at a fixed minimum screen height and hold each for at least 1.5 seconds.
Do not add UI panels, legends, counters, or decorative dashboard controls.

falsifier: The visual story is falsified if the source thread can reach the receipt without crossing the capsule or without producing the torus/cusp witness. The paper claim is refuted by a reproducible source-to-world counterexample in which the proposed S6 connection fails; the reference image cannot establish or refute that mathematics by itself.
